title: oncidium × ludwigianum
intro: Oncidium × ludwigianum, commonly known as the Ludwig's Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species that is a cross between Oncidium flexuosum and Cynoches truncatum. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Oncidium × ludwigianum include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
